title: Vine Boom on Damage
description: This project replaces every damage sound with the Vine Boom
body:
This project adds the Vine Boom sound to minecraft via damage. I made it so that whenever you:

-Are on Fire

-Are Drowning

-Take Fall Damage

-Freeze

-Are in a Sweet Berry Bush

Then the Vine Boom sound effect plays.

Note: The Sweet Berry Bush Doesn't seem to do it every time it damages you.

---
Installation:

-Locate the %Appdata% folder (Type %Appdata% into the run command)

-Inside the %Appdata% folder find the .minecraft folder and the resourcepacks folder

-Place the pack inside the resourcepacks folder

-Activate it inside minecraft
